ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Cheating in exams

2. Which response best shows understanding of Toileting? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Toileting.
   B. Apply the teaching of Toileting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Toileting to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Toileting has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Pillars of Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Islam.
   D. Say Pillars of Islam has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)
   A. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.
   D. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of The Arabic? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Arabic.
   B. Use The Arabic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say The Arabic has no place in daily life.

6. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

7. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS.

8. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

9. Which response best shows understanding of Eid? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Eid with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Eid has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Eid.
   D. Use Eid to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Allah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in Allah has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Allah.
   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in Allah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Belief in Allah to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.
   D. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in His? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in His has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Belief in His to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in His.
   D. Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Surah has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Surah.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
14. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Relationship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Eid and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain The Arabic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic Etiquette TEACHINGS and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Toileting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
